jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Partnerships, Engagement & Development Officer to help strengthen BSB's external profile, contribute to student enrolment growth and support the development of future fundraising and community engagement initiatives. 
  
Reporting to the Marketing & Admissions Director, you will build and manage strategic relationships with organisations, businesses, embassies, international networks and community groups that can help connect prospective families with BSB. You will also help develop partnership and fundraising opportunities that support the School's long-term objectives.

• Identify, develop and maintain strategic relationships with businesses, embassies, international organisations, relocation providers, chambers of commerce and community groups.  
• Build a strong network of external partners who can support student recruitment, community engagement and the School's wider strategic objectives.  
• Create and manage partnership initiatives that deliver mutual value and long-term engagement.   Business Development & Outreach

• Experience identifying and pursuing new opportunities, rather than solely managing existing accounts.  
• Experience managing multiple opportunities and priorities simultaneously and delivering against agreed objectives.

jobs.occupation: Extrusion Operator – 2 Shifts & Permanent Night Shift
jobs.description:
For a company in regio Wielsbeke we are looking for motivated and technically skilled Extrusion Operators to join the production team. We have opportunities available in both a two-shift system (early and late shifts) and a permanent night shift.

As an Extrusion Operator, you will be responsible for operating and monitoring extrusion machinery to ensure efficient production and consistent product quality.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Operate and monitor extrusion machines and production lines.

• Set up machines and adjust process parameters according to production requirements.

• Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with quality standards.

• Perform routine quality checks and make adjustments when necessary.

• Identify and report machine malfunctions or production issues.

• Carry out basic cleaning and maintenance tasks.

• Follow all health, safety, and production procedures.

• Work closely with colleagues and supervisors to achieve production targets.

 

Your Profile:

• Experience in extrusion or a similar production environment is an advantage.

• Technical understanding and a hands-on approach.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Flexible and willing to work either a two-shift system or a permanent night shift.

• Reliable, motivated, and eager to learn.

• You speak English or Dutch fluently.

As a Press Line Machine Operator, you are responsible for operating the equipment on the press line, ensuring that the clay is shaped and compacted to the correct form and density before the bricks enter the kiln.  Your Key Responsibilities:

• Preparing the production line according to the planned production schedule.

• Setting up and changing over the equipment to meet the required specifications.

• Operating the production line and monitoring/adjusting parameters in accordance with established procedures.

• Managing the loading and unloading of the drying chambers.

• Replenishing the hood kiln.

• Monitoring and adjusting the quality of the bricks produced.

• Recording production data and technical observations.

• Carrying out minor maintenance tasks and ensuring a clean and tidy working environment. 

Who Are You?

 

• You have a technical qualification or a strong technical aptitude.

• You have a basic understanding of automated equipment and systems.

• You have several years of experience as a machine operator or in operating more complex equipment, preferably in a production environment.

• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.

• You are willing to work day shifts, starting at 7:30 a.m.

jobs.occupation: Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering Data Centres
jobs.description:
As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you will join an international engineering and consultancy firm specialising in the design and delivery of complex technical projects.

Within this position, the focus is on Mission Critical Facilities and data centres. These are technically demanding buildings where systems such as electrical power supply, cooling, redundancy, safety and operational continuity need to be closely integrated.

You will become part of a Belgian engineering team that is being further developed around data centre projects. From Belgium, you will work closely with international engineering teams on projects for both national and international clients.

You will work in a multidisciplinary environment where different technical areas of expertise come together to design and deliver complex projects.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you coordinate the entire engineering and design process. You monitor the technical scope, planning and engineering budget, ensuring that the different disciplines work together towards one integrated design.

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams within complex data centre projects

• Manage the technical scope, engineering budget and associated contract documentation

• Prepare and monitor the engineering schedule and allocate tasks within the team

• Coordinate the different technical disciplines and ensure alignment between their designs

• Coordinate collaboration between Belgian and international engineering teams

• Work closely with external consultants, contractors and other technical partners

• Review technical design decisions and challenge or adjust them where necessary

• Manage design changes and assess their impact on the overall project

• Translate complex client requirements into technically feasible solutions

• Present and discuss technical concepts with clients and project teams

• Remain involved during the execution phase and act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders

For the position of Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, we are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent coordination skills. Experience within data centres is an advantage, but experience with industrial buildings or other technically complex building projects can also be a strong match.

• You hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• You have at least 5 years of experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects

• You have experience leading and coordinating engineers and other technical stakeholders

• You are familiar with complex technical building installations and multidisciplinary engineering

• Experience with data centres, industrial buildings or other complex built environments is a strong advantage

• You are familiar with digital engineering processes, 3D design and BIM environments

• You have a good understanding of relevant standards, regulations and working methods within engineering and construction

• You communicate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors and clients

• English knowledge is a must, Dutch and French are a plus

Relevant experience is essential for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previously worked in a similar role, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects within data centres, industrial buildings or other technically complex environments.

If you do not have relevant experience in a comparable position or project environment, we kindly ask you not to apply for this vacancy.
